date_note: El Comercio gives the offer as posted and Reniec's reply on 24 November, the day of publication; the page gives no earlier day.
title: Claim: seller offers Peruvians' personal data; Reniec says it found no breach
org: Reniec (Registro Nacional de Identificación y Estado Civil)
geo_basis: country named by the source; no city given
summary: El Comercio reports that a seller calling themselves TEAMSTARS offered on a clandestine forum data said to cover Peruvians' personal information, which threat-monitoring platforms including VECERT detected. The article says the authenticity is not confirmed. Reniec said that after technical checks it found no breach of its databases or digital certification infrastructure, and asked the national police cybercrime division to investigate.
plain: A seller claims to offer data on Peruvians. Reniec, Peru's identity registry, says its checks found no breach; the article says the claim is not confirmed.
exec: An unverified sale offer claims data on Peruvians; Reniec says it found no breach and has asked police to investigate.

evidence.quote: ¿Una nueva filtración masiva en Reniec? Qué se sabe de la supuesta venta de datos de 33 millones de peruanos
Un presunto ciberdelincuente asegura haber obtenido información personal, incluida información biométrica, de más de 33 millones de ciudadanos peruanos

validation.note: El Comercio only; it relays the forum offer and Reniec's reply. Claim not independently verified.
